verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that sandboxes can boot from Vercel Managed Images, shared or public images, or your own OCI images stored in Vercel Container Registry. They also say existing Docker images can be pushed to VCR to create sandboxes, and that custom images with baked-in tooling can be shared across projects and teams. Snapshots add a reusable, template-like starting state. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed documentation of the image build/push workflow and its constraints (e.g., supported registries beyond VCR)
